description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Rot Hulk enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger, returning Ravenous Rotbelly from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Ravenous Rotbelly enters, it and Necroduality trigger.
Resolve the Ravenous Rotbelly trigger, sacrificing it.
When you sacrifice Ravenous Rotbelly, it triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger, creating a token copy of Ravenous Rotbelly.
When the token Ravenous Rotbelly enters, it triggers, sacrificing Rot Hulk.
When you sacrifice Rot Hulk, it triggers, causing each opponent to sacrifice a creature.
Resolve the Necroduality trigger from step 2, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token Rot Hulk enters, it triggers, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
